Finding: Column headers of the IgG2a/IgG1 quotient blocks are rotated relative to the subclass titres they are computed from.
Evidence: S03-B columns reproduce the S13-A/S13-B quotients exactly (5/5 animals each) but under other names: printed "PSLN-212" = quotient of PSLN-212(Y); printed "PSLN-344" = quotient of PSLN-212; printed "PSLN-212(Y)" = quotient of PSLN-344. S03-F shows the same rotation against S13-C/S13-D ("PSLN-212" = PSLN-212(Y); "PSLN-344" = PSLN-212; "PSLN-212(Y)" = PSLN-344). The rank order of total IgG (S03-A/E: PSLN-212 < PSLN-344 < PSLN-212(Y)) agrees with the S13 labels.
Impact: As printed, PSLN-344 would look Th2-skewed (ratio 0.58 / 0.51, the lowest of the three). Recomputed from S13: PSLN-344 2.14 / 2.73; PSLN-212 0.58 / 0.51; PSLN-212(Y) 2.97 / 2.89 (means).
Handling_in_this_analysis: S03-B and S03-F not used as printed; ratios recomputed from S13-A..D.
Gate0_action: Confirm group identity of S13-A..D and S03-B/F columns against plate maps.

Finding: Both cytokine panels on S09 are labelled "16h"; the right-hand panel is the 72 h time point.
Evidence: 10^(Ifnb1 row) of the right panel (S09!Y3:AS3) equals the 72 h Ifnb1 values of S01-A (S01!H3:L9) for 21/21 animals; the left panel (S09!B3:V3) equals the 16 h values (S01!B3:F9) for 21/21. The "PBS" group of S09-A carries the values of the "Sham" group of S01-A.
Impact: Read as printed, the right panel would be taken as a discordant 16 h replicate. Read correctly it shows that Il6, Tnf, Ccl2 are still elevated at 72 h with PSLN-344.
Handling_in_this_analysis: Right panel analysed as 72 h. Control group treated as the common control (PBS/Sham identity unresolved).
Gate0_action: Correct the label; confirm whether the control was PBS or empty liposome.

Finding: Two nominally different challenge experiments (rgH5N1 at day 14 vs day 3) carry identical time-to-event data in all four groups.
Evidence: S06!M3:Q30 equals S06!A34:E61 in all four groups; Sham deaths on days 4,4,5,6,6,6,7 and PSLN-212 deaths on days 5,8,10,10,12 in both. The linked body-weight blocks differ from each other (S15-C vs S15-D), and S15-D implies 5/7, not 7/7, survivors for PSLN-344 and for PSLN-212(Y). Separately, the Sham columns of S06-B and S06-F carry the same seven death days (4,4,4,5,5,6,6); their other columns differ.
Impact: One of the two blocks is probably a paste of the other; the 7/7 PSLN-344 result is counted twice in any pooled analysis.
Handling_in_this_analysis: Primary pooled analysis as printed; sensitivity analysis drops S06-C and uses body-weight-inferred counts for S06-D.
Gate0_action: Retrieve both survival records from cage cards.

Finding: The neutrophil block (S11-B) largely duplicates the alveolar-macrophage block (S11-A).
Evidence: 8 of 20 animal time-series are identical at >=4 of 5 time points (Vaccine rep1=rep1 (4/5); Vaccine rep2=rep2 (5/5); PSLN-212 rep1=rep1 (5/5); PSLN-212 rep4=rep2 (5/5); PSLN-344 rep1=rep1 (5/5); PSLN-344 rep2=rep2 (5/5); PSLN-212(Y) rep1=rep1 (5/5); PSLN-212(Y) rep2=rep2 (5/5)); the 20 group-by-day means correlate r=0.997 (max difference 2.5 points).
Impact: There is no independent neutrophil data set, i.e. no usable read-out of acute lung inflammation by cell influx.
Handling_in_this_analysis: S11-B excluded. S11-A used only descriptively.
Gate0_action: Re-export neutrophil gate from FACS files.

Finding: Body-weight traces of the PSLN-344 group after day-14 rgH5N1 challenge are the traces of a different experiment (day-3 challenge).
Evidence: 40 of the 42 values for days 2-12 are identical animal by animal (S15!W24:AC29 vs S15!W73:AC78); 7/7 animals match at >=4 time points; 0 of 7 day-14 values match.
Impact: S15-C weight data for PSLN-344 are not independent evidence; the day-14 values in S15-C do not continue the traces (e.g. animal 3: 77.9 at day 12, 90.1 at day 14).
Handling_in_this_analysis: S15-C PSLN-344 weights not used. Survival taken from S06-C with flag Q03.

Blocks: S15-M (young C57BL/6, PSLN-212(Y)) vs S09-E (young BALB/c, PSLN-344Y)
Finding: Weight traces of the young C57BL/6 reference group re-use traces from a BALB/c experiment with a different adjuvant.
Evidence: 33 of 49 post-baseline values identical; 6/7 animals match at >=4 of 7 time points (S15!I104:O110 vs S09!W40:AD46).
Impact: Cross-strain weight evidence (S15-M) is not independent. S15-M also shows 7/7 young animals alive while S15-L records one death (day 12).
Handling_in_this_analysis: Cross-strain conclusions rest on the time-to-event blocks S15-L/N only and are graded "moderate".

Finding: Several PSLN-344 animals share weight traces across BALB/c, C57BL/6 and Swiss Webster experiments.

Handling_in_this_analysis: Same as Q06.

Blocks: Time-to-event blocks vs their linked body-weight blocks
Finding: Survivor counts or animal numbers disagree between the survival block and the weight block of the same animals in 10 groups.
Evidence: S09-F/S09-G Sham: survival block 0/7, weight traces imply 0/8; S03-I/S13-F PSLN-212: survival block 0/7, weight traces imply 3/7; S03-J/S13-G Sham: survival block 1/10, weight traces imply 5/10; S06-C/S15-C PSLN-212: survival block 2/7, weight traces imply 1/7; S06-D/S15-D PSLN-212(Y): survival block 7/7, weight traces imply 5/7; S06-D/S15-D PSLN-344: survival block 7/7, weight traces imply 5/7; S06-E/S15-E PSLN-212: survival block 0/7, weight traces imply 1/7; S06-E/S15-E PSLN-344: survival block 5/7, weight traces imply 6/7; S06-G/S15-G PSLN-344: survival block 4/7, weight traces imply 5/7; S15-L/S15-M PSLN-212(Y): survival block 6/7, weight traces imply 7/7. (Weight traces frozen at a constant value to day 14, or blank, are read as deaths; the annotation describes these groups as "declining".)
Impact: Individual survival fractions are uncertain by 1-3 animals in the flagged groups; direction of every PSLN-344 vs PSLN-212 comparison is unchanged.
Handling_in_this_analysis: Survival blocks used as printed; worst-case sensitivity analysis uses the weight-inferred count wherever it is less favourable to PSLN-344 or more favourable to PSLN-212.

Blocks: S03-I vs S13-F; S03-J vs S13-G
Finding: Survival and weight blocks said to describe the same animals list different groups.
Evidence: S03-I lists Sham, CMP-204, PSLN-212, PSLN-344, PSLN-212(Y); S13-F lists PSLN-212(Y), Sham, PSLN-212, PSLN-344, Naïve. S03-J lists Sham, PSLN-212, PSLN-344; S13-G lists PSLN-344, Sham, Naïve. In S13-G the 'Sham' traces (5 dead by d14, deaths from d10) resemble S03-J 'PSLN-212' (deaths d10-12, 3/10 alive) and the 'Naive' traces (1/10 alive, two deaths by d4) resemble S03-J 'Sham' (1/10 alive, deaths d3, d4, d9-10).
Impact: The identity of the comparator arms in the wild-type H5N1 experiment is uncertain (PSLN-212 and Sham, or Sham and Naive). The PSLN-344 arm (10/10 alive in both blocks) is not affected. In S03-I the PSLN-212 arm (0/7, all dead by day 6, faster than Sham) conflicts with S13-F (3/7 alive).
Handling_in_this_analysis: S03-I and S03-J reported as printed but excluded from the conservative pooled analysis; S03-J not described as a clean head-to-head.
Gate0_action: Establish the true arm list for both experiments.

Finding: Stated n differs from the number of observations.
Evidence: S03-J stated n=9, 10 rows per group, and one PSLN-344 row has status 0 but no day (S03!J46, G46 empty); S05-A/B stated n=3, 2 values per group and day; S13-E stated n=5, 7 per group; S09-F Sham has 7 events for 8 animals in the weight block S09-G (the annotation attributes the 7 to S09-B, where the workbook has 8); S08-D PSLN-212/R848 has 4 of 5 values at day 10 (S08!W26 empty).
Impact: Denominators uncertain by one animal in the affected groups.
Handling_in_this_analysis: Observed counts used; the PSLN-344 row without a day treated as censored at the end of observation.

Finding: Epithelial-uptake block is inconsistent with the earlier block for the same formulation.
Evidence: S01-B: AECII/PSLN-SRB mean 15.8 %, AECI/PSLN-SRB 3.8 %. S08-C as printed: AECII-PSLN-SRB 15.8, AECII-PSLN-344-SRB 3.8, AECI-PSLN-SRB 13.8, AECI-PSLN-344-SRB 3.0. The first two S08-C columns share 3 and 2 of 5 values with the S01-B AECII and AECI columns.
Impact: Either Mn lowers epithelial uptake about four-fold (as printed) or the column order is AECII, AECI, AECII, AECI and Mn changes nothing. Unresolved.
Handling_in_this_analysis: No claim made on the effect of Mn on uptake.
Gate0_action: Check column order against FACS export; gating differs between the two blocks.

Impact: Background mortality of about 19 % in 14 days among untreated aged animals (stated age 20 months) limits what the day-60 challenge can show.
Handling_in_this_analysis: Day-60 results interpreted against this background.
